title: Phase 3 Bunionectomy Study
official: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of CPL-01 in the Management of Postoperative Pain After Unilateral Distal First Metatarsal Bunionectomy With Osteotomy
summary: Patients with a bunion will have that repaired and then pain and rescue medicine use will be evaluated.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Bunion

Exclusion Criteria:

* Concomitant conditions
